title: Spec'ing Your Next Fleet: Matching Truck to Task the Right Way
description: Duty cycle, terrain and payload decide the spec. Getting it wrong costs you on every mile.
body:
PLACEHOLDER COPY — the design handoff supplied this article's title and category only. Replace this body before launch.

This article will walk through how we spec a truck against the work it actually does: axle configuration, horsepower and torque against terrain, and where a cheaper spec ends up costing more over a five-year hold.
